metadata.description: Official Pathmode plugin marketplace: product intent tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: pathmode
plugins.description: Turn a vague feature idea into a spec your coding agent can build against. Pathmode interrogates the intent behind a request, writes it to intent.md in your repo, then checks the code that comes back against the outcomes and constraints you agreed to. Free: runs with no account or API key, using the models you already have access to in Claude Code. Home: https://preflight.pathmode.io. Connect a Pathmode workspace to sync intent and evidence across a team.
